# Arabidopsis N-glycosylation benchmark

An unmodified copy of one experimental ETD spectrum (scan 3863) extracted from the authors' MSViewer MGF; intensities and m/z values are preserved. The identification is from Supplement2.xlsx, sheet “S Table1, FOR MS VIEWER”, row 2 of *N-Glycopeptide Profiling in Arabidopsis Inflorescence* (PMC5083099). Species: Arabidopsis thaliana; protein AT1G01300.1; peptide NVTHAPRPGGFSSSVVSGLSQGSGEYFTR; HexNAc at peptide Asn1 / protein Asn117; precursor 796.8908, 4+; RT 34.317 min; Protein Prospector score 58.2, expectation 9e-9.

This example displays the source-assigned single HexNAc remnant at an NVT sequon. It does not infer an intact glycan structure or independently validate site localization. ETD annotation uses intact-modification c and z-radical backbone ions at charges 1–3 and a default 0.6 Da fragment tolerance. Matches are mass-based, not a new peptide identification or FDR estimate. The low-resolution fragment data should not be judged with the high-resolution Kac tolerance.

All provenance URLs and SHA256 hashes are in metadata.tsv. The publication reports PXD003008, while the current MassIVE MSV000079345 record lists PXD004579; the benchmark uses the stable MassIVE accession and author MSViewer key to avoid conflating these identifiers. MassIVE marks the dataset public / CC0.
